# @pencroff-lab/kore

> TypeScript core utilities library providing value-based error handling
> with Go-style `Err` and `Outcome<T>` types. Published to npm as a dual
> ESM/CJS package.

## Core Modules

- [Err](src/types/err.ts): Immutable, value-based error type with wrapping (cause chains), aggregation, hierarchical error codes, JSON serialization, and conversion to native Error
- [Outcome](src/types/outcome.ts): Monadic result container wrapping `[T, null] | [null, Err]` with map/pipe chains, combinators (all, any), side effects, and terminal operations
- [Logger](src/utils/logger.ts): Structured, level-filtered logging with pluggable transports and Err integration
- [dtStamp](src/utils/format_dt.ts): Compact, sortable date/time stamps for file names, log prefixes, and IDs

## Type Definitions

- [Err types](src/types/err.types.ts): ErrCode, ErrOptions, ErrJSON, ToStringOptions
- [Outcome types](src/types/outcome.types.ts): ResultTuple, OutcomeCallback, PipeCallback

## Usage Examples

- [Err examples](src/types/err.examples.test.ts): Error creation, wrapping, codes, serialization
- [Outcome examples](src/types/outcome.examples.test.ts): Mapping, piping, combinators, error handling
- [Logger examples](src/utils/logger.examples.test.ts): Log levels, transports, child loggers
- [dtStamp examples](src/utils/format_dt.examples.test.ts): Date formatting options

## Guides

- [Error handling patterns](docs/guides/error-handling-patterns.md): Err and Outcome composition, propagation, real-world scenarios
- [Migration from throwing](docs/guides/migration-from-throwing.md): Step-by-step try/catch to Outcome conversion

## Optional

- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Full development rules, architecture, and conventions
- [API reference](docs/api/): Generated TypeDoc documentation

## Quick Start

```typescript
import { Err, Outcome } from "@pencroff-lab/kore/types";
import { dtStamp, log, createLogger } from "@pencroff-lab/kore/utils";
```

## Install

```bash
npm install @pencroff-lab/kore
```
